newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon Opal weakening over Southern Japan -WSC.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Opal weakening over Southern Japan -WSC.

text.p: Typhoon Opal is over southern Honshu, Japan, moving northeast at 22 mph with top winds of 75 mph but rapidly weakening and losing tropical characteristics as it passes over Honshu, private forecaster Weather Services said.
It will turn east northeast and move out to sea east of Japan during the next 24 hours. Opal is also a threat to shipping along the coast of Japan.

Wind damage is likely during the next few hours, then winds will become less of a problem as the storm weakens. Heavy rainfall will likely lead to flash flooding and mudslides over the mountains of Honshu.
